summary.text: Mike Hornby (Michael Hornby) is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 93, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a publisher and entrepreneur who has served since December 1, 2022.

paragraphs.text: Michael Hornby was born in Chiredzi, Zimbabwe, lives in West Virginia, and earned his education from St. John's College in 1993.
His career experience includes working as publisher and CEO of Hornby Publishing.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Hornby described himself as a self-made entrepreneur and listed small business and economic development, lower taxes and less government regulation as his key messages.
He said education, agriculture and economic development are the policy areas he is most passionate about.
